ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: The app uses your camera to capture photos as evidence of your clock-in and clock-out.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: The app uses your photos to attach evidence for a sick leave request.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: The app uses your location to confirm you are within the Faculty of Engineering when you clock in for official duty.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: The app uses your location to confirm you are within the Faculty of Engineering when you clock in for official duty.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to unlock the Intania One app.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: The app connects to a test server inside the Faculty of Engineering network to fetch data during the testing period.
